entries.text: Well, after the Great War, my Vault was one of the first to open. [Takes a deep breath] Whew.  Long time.

entries.text: All started with the sirens.  I was young, but ohh, I do remember that.  Lotta terrible years followed.  And I remember walking outta the Vault late one morning.

entries.text: Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. [Coughs]

entries.text: [Cough] Trouble.  Nothing but trouble.
entries.source_text: [Cough] Trouble.  Nothing but trouble.

entries.text: Brilliant guy.  A doctor and philosopher.  Long ago he lead the expedition where I got changed into a mutant.
